name: Critical Severity Incident/Finding SLA
notes: Applicable to active system compromise, data breaches, or verified critical vulnerabilities (RCE, SQLi, Auth Bypass) in customer environments.

name: High Severity Security Finding SLA
notes: Applicable to severe security vulnerabilities like privilege escalation, IDOR, and high-impact authentication weaknesses. Requires L2/Tier 2 attention within 4 hours.

name: Medium Severity Review/Query SLA
notes: Applicable to draft pentest report reviews, compliance gap analysis queries, and medium-severity findings (CSRF, outdated software versions).

name: Low Severity General Support SLA
notes: Applicable to general inquiries, quote requests, scoping questionnaires, and low-severity findings (missing security headers, TLS configuration recommendations).
